summary_1line: Arjuna devastates the Kaurava army while advancing toward Jayadratha; Krishna creates false sunset with yoga to lure Jayadratha out for Arjuna’s vowed kill.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his chariot with Krishna as charioteer, Gandiva blazing as thousands of fiery arrows fill the sky like meteors.
The battlefield becomes a river of blood and broken weapons, with severed banners, elephants, and chariots floating like rafts.
Under an artificial twilight created by Krishna, Jayadratha looks up at the darkened sky while Arjuna draws a divine arrow to strike.
